Hi Molly — great to meet you and thanks for the attachments. Looping in Lauren (Marketplace Ops) and Vanessa (FinOps) to help with PO mapping and billing.

High level answers and next steps:

- PO lanes: We typically map separate marketplace vendor IDs per cloud (so AWS and GCP have distinct vendor mappings) when customers request marketplace billing. However, for native private-offer flows we can map a single Redwood billing entity and accept marketplace-specific PO numbers. We'll confirm the vendor IDs for NimbusBridge in the vendor registry.
- Coupa: We accept Coupa PO numbers. For the first procurement we often set up a private-offer route if the customer wants invoiced marketplace billing; otherwise Coupa PO -> marketplace vendor ID mapping works.
- Tax: The W-9 is perfect for US entity. If you have customers in EU later we'll ask for VAT/EORI as applicable.

Action items I'm proposing:
1) Marketplace Ops (Lauren) to provision vendor IDs for AWS and GCP and share mapping.
2) FinOps (Vanessa) to validate billing entity and contracts needed for private offers.
3) Create a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones: vendor provisioning, PO mapping, QA listing, go-live. I'll draft a one-page MAP and share a Drive link for signatures.

Can you confirm your legal entity name exactly as it should appear on invoices and the primary billing contact? Also please confirm whether NimbusBridge intends to sell via marketplace meter charges or prefer invoiced purchases for initial customers.

I'll attach a short vendor-intake-checklist for internal ops.

Best,
